newsitem.title: USA: U.S. barges quoted mostly steady to lower on call.
newsitem.headline: U.S. barges quoted mostly steady to lower on call.

text.p: U.S. barge rates were quoted at mostly steady to lower levels on the St. Louis Merchants Exchange call session. No barges traded on Wednesday versus none on Tuesday, Exchange sources said.
- One barge this week Illinois River bid five points lower at 145 percent of tariff, offered at 160 percent.
- Two barges next week lower Ohio offered at 150 percent, no bid.
- Five barges, one each week December, Illinois, offered at a steady 150 percent, no bid.
- Ten barges, two each week December, lower Ohio River, offered 2-1/2 points lower at 122-1/2 percent, bid at 115 percent (based on one barge per week).
- Four barges, one each week January, Mississippi (St. Louis) offered at 115 percent, no bid or comparison.
- Eight barges, two each week January, lower Ohio offered at 125 percent, no bid or comparison.
- Four barges, one each week January, Illinois bid five points lower at 180 percent, offered at 200 percent.
